def find_path(graph, start, goal):
    if start not in graph or goal not in graph:
        return None
    visited = set()
    path = []
    stack = [[start]]
    while stack:
        path = stack.pop()
        node = path[-1]
        if node == goal:
            return path
        if node not in visited:
            visited.add(node)
            neighbours = graph[node]
            for neighbour in neighbours:
                new_path = list(path)
                new_path.append(neighbour)
                stack.append(new_path)
    return None
